formulas.formula: Every bill, claim and dollar of your family's health costs in one place.
Setup: the year, your family members, deductibles, out-of-pocket max and HSA/FSA starting balance.
Expenses: every bill. Billed, what insurance paid, and what you've paid. Your share and what you still owe fill in.
Deductible: see how close each person (and the family) is to the deductible and out-of-pocket max.
Bills: unpaid balances by due date. HSA-FSA: contributions and what you've spent from the account.
Tax: a quick estimate of the medical expense deduction (only if you itemize).
Match each bill to the insurer's Explanation of Benefits before you pay.
Mistakes are common, especially on hospital bills.
Mark Denied or Appealed. Most appeals are worth a phone call.
Many providers offer 0% plans. Log each payment in Paid so far.
